product_overview: MediFlow is a cloud-native SaaS platform to unify clinic operations: scheduling, electronic medical records (PEP), and financial management with automated repasses. It focuses on privacy-compliant workflows, Google Calendar sync, and automating administrative work to reduce no-shows and glosas.
core_goals: Provide a secure, multi-tenant clinic management platform with role-based access control and audit logging.
Deliver an integrated scheduling system with bidirectional Google Calendar sync and automated confirmation to reduce no-shows.
Offer a legally-compliant PEP (SOAP) with signing/versioning and addendum support to protect clinical integrity.
Automate financial flows including transaction management, cashier closures and split payments to ensure transparent, accurate repasses to professionals.
Ship a polished UX to minimize training time for receptionists and clinicians and speed day-to-day operations.

features.name: Authentication & Session
features.description: Email/password login with session restoration, role loading and logout; HttpOnly cookies are used to secure sessions and load current user/role context.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Click "Entrar" to authenticate -> See /dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter incorrect email or password -> Click "Entrar" to authenticate -> See authentication error message and remain on /login
Visit / (entry) with valid session cookie -> System loads session and current user -> Redirect to /dashboard
While on /dashboard -> Click Logout -> Session cleared -> Redirect to /login

features.name: Appointments (Agenda)
features.description: Calendar-based appointment management: create, list, change status, delete and filter appointments by professional and date, with conflict resolution for Google-synced blocks.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/agenda -> Select professional from filter -> Switch to day view -> Click New Appointment -> Create an appointment with patient/procedure/time -> Click Save -> See appointment card in calendar
Navigate to /dashboard/agenda -> Click existing appointment card -> Change appointment status to confirmed -> See appointment status update in calendar

Navigate to /dashboard/agenda -> Select professional -> Click New Appointment -> Choose a time that is blocked as "Ocupado" by external calendar -> Click Save -> See conflict alert preventing creation -> Cancel or resolve conflict
Navigate to /dashboard/agenda -> Click appointment card -> Click Delete appointment -> Confirm deletion -> See appointment removed from calendar

features.name: Schedule Config & Blocks
features.description: Configure weekly availability per professional and create date/period blocks (vacation, holidays), with edit/remove capabilities.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/agenda/configuracao -> Select staff profile -> Enable/disable days of week and set periods -> Click Save schedule configuration -> See success confirmation
Navigate to /dashboard/agenda/configuracao -> Click Add Block -> Add a block (vacation/holiday/period) with start and end dates -> Click Save -> See new block listed

Navigate to /dashboard/agenda/configuracao -> Click Add Block -> Enter block dates that overlap existing confirmed appointments -> Click Save -> See warning about affected appointments -> Choose to proceed or cancel
Navigate to /dashboard/agenda/configuracao -> Select an existing block -> Click Edit -> Modify dates -> Click Save -> See updated block in list

features.name: Cadastros: Patients, Staff, Procedures, Suppliers
features.description: Master-data CRUD for patients, staff (roles, commission rules), procedures (pricing) and suppliers, including linkage between staff and procedures.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/pacientes -> Click New Patient -> Fill patient form including CPF and contact -> Click Save -> See new patient in list
Navigate to /dashboard/pacientes -> Click New Patient -> Fill patient form using an existing CPF -> Click Save -> See duplicate CPF error and prevent creation
Navigate to /dashboard/equipe -> Click Add Staff -> Fill staff details and assign roles and procedures -> Click Save -> See staff member in team list
Navigate to /dashboard/cadastros/procedimentos -> Click New Procedure -> Fill procedure name and pricing -> Click Save -> See procedure listed
Navigate to /dashboard/cadastros/fornecedores -> Click New Supplier -> Fill supplier details -> Click Save -> See supplier in list

features.name: Electronic Medical Record (PEP)
features.description: Create, update and finalize SOAP-based medical records, add addendums, link records to appointments and enforce immutability after electronic signature.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/pep -> Select patient -> Click New Record -> Link appointment -> Fill SOAP fields (Subjetivo, Objetivo, Avaliação, Plano) -> Click Finalize the record -> See record marked as finalized
Navigate to /dashboard/pep -> Open a finalized record -> Click Add an addendum -> Fill addendum content -> Click Save -> See addendum attached to the finalized record
Navigate to /dashboard/pep -> Open a finalized record -> Attempt to edit SOAP fields -> See edit blocked and instruction to create addendum instead
Navigate to /dashboard/pep -> Select patient -> View medical record history -> See chronological list of records and addendums

features.name: Finance (Transactions, Closures, Medical Fees) & Reports
features.description: Manage income/expense transactions, daily cashier closures, close medical fee payments (repasse), manage expense categories and generate PDF reports for billing and closures.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/financeiro -> Click Add Transaction -> Fill income transaction details -> Click Save -> See transaction appear in transactions list
Navigate to /dashboard/financeiro -> Select day -> Click Close receptionist cash box for selected day -> Confirm close -> See closure record and status
Navigate to /dashboard/financeiro -> Click Medical Fees -> Click Close medical fee payments -> Click Download repasse report -> See repasse PDF downloaded
Navigate to /dashboard/financeiro/categorias -> Click Add Category -> Fill category name and parent (optional) -> Click Save -> See category displayed in hierarchical tree
Navigate to /dashboard/financeiro -> Click Add Transaction -> Leave required fields empty -> Click Save -> See validation errors and prevent transaction save
